# URLs Hugo (PaperMod, archive/hugo:hugo.yaml) emitted but did NOT list in its sitemap.
# Derived from config + content, not crawled:
#  - outputs.home = HTML, RSS, JSON  -> /index.json (PaperMod search index)
#  - Hugo emits an RSS feed for every section, taxonomy and term -> /posts/, /videos/, /authors/ (+terms), /tags/, /categories/ (+terms)
#  - hugo.yaml sets no paginate, so the default (10 per page) applies; 11 posts are published -> /posts/page/2/ exists (and /posts/page/1/ is an alias redirect page)
# Index pages /authors/ and /categories/ are already in hugo-urls.txt.
# Static files Hugo served from the posts/ tree (bare images and page-bundle images), copied byte-for-byte into public/.
# /sitemap.xml was registered with search engines. Page-1 aliases (/<section>/page/1/) are emitted by Hugo for every paginated list.
